text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Tamamo Cross rejoiced that 
as a daughter, she was able to leave her 
hoofprints on the Tenno Sho (Spring)—her 
father's dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the very next day—urgent news 
came from her family, leaving her standing 
frozen in shock.
